head_commit.message:
research(grey-deer): readiness-floor projection and episode-rule options diagnosis (W8) (#9215)

* research(grey-deer): project years until pullback readiness floors

Exploratory Poisson-Jeffreys planning projection for the SPY forward lane
and a D9 panel lane. Panel h=21 stays not reachable: the stored history
is one episode window.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* diagnose why the panel date-axis episode rule collapses

Reproduce the frozen v1.1 cluster and episode counts from the union event
dates, separate the gap rule from the window merge, and record v1.2 design
options with their honest-N consequences. The memo is not a prereg freeze.

Co-Authored-By: Grok lane <grok-lane@noreply.mastermind-x.com>

* ci(grey-deer): run the floor-projection and episode-rule-options tests in the stage-1 job

Adds scripts/research/grey_deer_pullback_floor_projection.py, grey_deer_pullback_episode_rule_options.py
and their test files to the grey-deer-pullback-stage1 exclusive job's paths and pytest step. Both tests are
synthetic (tmp_path inputs); the episode-rule script imports only the stage-1 module the job already covers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(grey-deer): declare W8's research inputs; keep W8 lines apart from W7's

The closure check reported three committed files the W8 scripts read but
the job did not declare: the v1.2 options memo and the two result JSONs.
They are now declared. W8's path and run entries also move to spots in the
grey-deer-pullback-stage1 job that #9208 does not touch, so the two PRs
merge in either order without a conflict.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(grey-deer): pin repo root unconditionally in episode-rule options script

The strong-pin law (tests/test_check_script_import_pinning.py) counts only a
top-level unconditional sys.path.insert derived from __file__; the
'if str(ROOT) not in sys.path' guard failed ci-pack-6 unrun-import-hygiene.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ci): carry the #9213 path-prune heal (SNI artifact scan prunes on relative path)

Identical one-line change to the dedicated heal PR, so this PR's merge ref passes
path-prune-lint (ci-pack-5) without waiting for that PR. Whichever merges first,
the other's diff on this line goes empty.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Sol CEO <actions@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
FIF A0: exclude an issuer whose statements cannot be reconstructed, typed, instead of aborting the publication (#9221)

* FIF A0: exclude an issuer whose statements cannot be reconstructed, typed, instead of aborting the publication

The 2026-10-13 schedule run of filing-forensics-sec failed in publish: one
SNOW 10-Q income statement with a ragged displayed grid raised
StatementGraphError out of _plan_issuer and aborted every issuer, AAPL
included.

The publisher now catches the three adjudicated displayed-statement
refusals (layout unsupported, table absent, columns absent) per issuer:
- the issuer is excluded as statement_reconstruction_refused:<slug>;
- its coverage accessions are withheld (served=False, served_withheld);
- a line-start ::warning annotation names it;
- the remaining issuers plan and publish as before.
Any other StatementGraphError still aborts the run. If every staged issuer
is refused, the report is written and the run fails typed
(statement_reconstruction_refused). verify_report admits only the closed
slug vocabulary and refuses a coverage row that serves an excluded issuer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* FIF A0: carry the refusal detail on the exclusion row and escape the annotation text

Review F2/F3/N2 on #9221: each statement_reconstruction_refused exclusion now
records the kernel's message as detail (like the other exclusion rows), the
warning annotation escapes %, CR and LF, and a new test drives a refusal from
the real reconstructor through the real plan path.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Heal ci-pack-1: prune __pycache__ on the SNI-root-relative path

tests/test_sni_injection_safety_ext.py (from #9213) pruned on the absolute
path parts, which the path-prune lint (#3802) refuses; main's ci-pack-1 is
red on it. Test-only, behaviour unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Sol CEO <actions@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
